items.english: If this advice is unavailable or unclear, do not reuse the water. Soil and mulch do not disinfect wastewater.
items.draft: Ukuba eli cebo alifumaneki okanye alicacanga, musa ukuphinda usebenzise amanzi. Umhlaba nengca yokugquma azibulali ntsholongwane emanzini angcolileyo.
items.backtranslation: If this advice is not available or not clear, do not reuse the water. Soil and mulch do not kill viruses in dirty water.
items.problem: "this advice" rendered "eli cebo" (this plan); "ntsholongwane" = virus only, narrower than germs/pathogens (safety text)
items.corrected: Ukuba le ngcebiso ayifumaneki okanye ayicacanga, musa ukuphinda usebenzise amanzi. Umhlaba nengca yokugquma azibulali magciwane emanzini angcolileyo.

items.english: Check with qualified local advisers before any reuse. Soil and mulch do not disinfect wastewater.
items.draft: Hlola nabacebisi basekuhlaleni abaqeqeshiweyo phambi kokuphinda usebenzise. Umhlaba nengca yokugquma azibulali ntsholongwane emanzini angcolileyo.
items.backtranslation: Check with trained local advisors before reuse. Soil and mulch do not kill viruses in dirty water.
items.problem: "ntsholongwane" = virus only; narrower than germs/pathogens/disinfect (safety text)
items.corrected: Hlola nabacebisi basekuhlaleni abaqeqeshiweyo phambi kokuphinda usebenzise. Umhlaba nengca yokugquma azibulali magciwane emanzini angcolileyo.

items.english: Prevent contact with people or animals. Do not connect washwater to drinking-water plumbing, spray it, let it pool, or allow it to run off the property into a street, drain or watercourse.
items.draft: Thintela ukunxibelelana nabantu okanye izilwanyana. Musa ukudibanisa amanzi okuhlamba nemibhobho yamanzi okusela, ukuwafafaza, ukuwayeka ame, okanye ukuwavumela aphume epropathini aye esitratweni, kwi-drain okanye emlanjeni.
items.backtranslation: Prevent contact with people or animals. Do not join wash water to drinking-water pipes, spray it, let it stand, or let it leave the property to the street, drain or stream.
items.problem: "ukunxibelelana nabantu" = communicating/connecting with people, not contact with the water
items.corrected: Thintela abantu okanye izilwanyana ukuba bachukumise la manzi. Musa ukudibanisa amanzi okuhlamba nemibhobho yamanzi okusela, ukuwafafaza, ukuwayeka ame, okanye ukuwavumela aphume epropathini aye esitratweni, kwi-drain okanye emlanjeni.
